text:
Testament


Having arrived at the time when

twilight no longer consoles me

and small omens diminish me;

having arrived at this

        time;


and since the coffee grounds

now suddenly open for me

        their round bitter mouths;


having arrived at this time;

and having lost already all

        hope of

some deserved promotion, of

seeing the serene flowing of shadow;


and possessing nothing more than this time;

possessing nothing more, in

        the end,

than my memory of the nights and

their enormous vibrant delicacy;


possessing nothing more

between heaven and earth than

my memory,

        than this time;


I decide to make my testament.

It is this:

I leave you

time,

        all the time.

translation.title: Testament
translation.editorial_note: The catalog title says 'Wonder,' but the visible body is 'Testament'; this entry preserves the heading.
